title: Treatment Effects on Latent Shannon Diversity: Patient Count versus Sequencing Depth
banked_reason: Math and decision panels PASS with no findings; D0.5.G tier=subfield and paper_score_ceiling 7.2 < 7.4 FIELD floor, salvageable=false; independent terminal validity consultation confirms no bounded same-assumption repair remains.
gap_reasons: The delivered fixed-design and budget theorems contain matching achievability and all-procedure converses, with no identified unresolved load-bearing step or stale matched-rate overclaim. Their application remains confined to iid patients and supplied common Poisson depth; the balanced-arm corollary proves upper certificates without establishing guarantees for the motivating blocked, longitudinal experiments. The two finite examples certify normalized interval radii approximately 0.6012 and 0.4160, leaving substantial uncertainty, and their illustrative prices do not establish practical recruitment-versus-sequencing efficiency. Exhaustive degree selection and certified root isolation lack a scalability guarantee, while universal-order comparisons do not establish optimal finite constants. [Polyanskiy–Wu](https://people.lids.mit.edu/yp/homepage/data/dual2.pdf) already supplies the abstract mixture duality, so the contribution rests on the explicit grouped-simplex channel and budget evaluation; the limited practical precision and implementation evidence constrain the projected leading-econometrics paper score to 7.2. [D0.5.G projected paper-score gate: paper_score_ceiling 7.2 < 7.4, so the graded tier 'field' is capped at 'subfield'. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]
proof_attempt_summary: Derived a uniformly matched patient-count, Poisson-depth, and alphabet Shannon-diversity frontier with original-record estimators, honest intervals, and an explicit budgeted patient-versus-depth allocation rule. Bounded salvage added sharper finite bias, exact pre-data degree selection, and reproducible 2048-bit certificates; math and decision panels passed, but the general reviewer capped the completed package at subfield below the required field floor. The run stopped before Lean formalization; reaching field requires new trial-design, empirical, sharp finite-constant, or computational-complexity work.
tldr: The proved FIELD-level results give explicit, uniformly matched patient-count, sequencing-depth and alphabet precision rates for a randomized treatment effect on normalized mean latent subject Shannon diversity. The attaining rule now examines every public degree from two through \(\lceil\sqrt S\rceil\), evaluates the exact factorial-score variance by certified root isolation, and chooses the smallest minimizer of a sharpened finite honest radius. Zero estimation and the full interval are used only when that minimized radius is at least one. Two reproducible worked budgets produce non-full intervals, with radii below \(0.602\) and \(0.417\). The unchanged closed-form budget rates, rounded allocation, same-simplex converses, factor-four grid certificate, and consistency/root-precision boundaries remain proved. A bounded conditional corollary gives the same upper certificates for fixed balanced arms with iid marginal sampling and known common Poisson depth. The causal target is mean subject entropy, not entropy of a pooled composition.
gap: Abstract mixture-functional duality leaves this grouped count channel unevaluated, and clean entropy theory concerns repeated reads from one composition. A patient-versus-sequencing budget comparison needs the complete finite-\((n,m,K)\) evaluation and its stability across feasible designs.
fill: The contribution sought is a budgeted minimax design theorem for mean subject Shannon contrast, with explicit rates \(\rho_R,\rho_L\), a total original-record attaining procedure and a finite certificate over \(\mathcal D_B\). The full fixed-design frontier is an indispensable technical engine; its unevaluated infimum over designs is insufficient.
